biggest_catch: This is the simplest program of the wave - $25 per referral with no product activity hurdles at all - but the payout only fires if the friend is a brand-new member, and HACU employees are excluded from the payout.
catches: Referrer earns $25 for every referral who joins the credit union, up to $500 per calendar year (20 successful referrals).
New member must open a new membership and cannot already be an existing member for the referrer to receive the payout.
Friend must give the referrer's full name when applying (online, branch, or phone).
Payout deposited into the referrer's primary savings account within 5 days of the new member account opening.
Accounts must be in good standing; must be 18+; HACU employees don't qualify.
Referral payout considered miscellaneous income and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC.
Offer subject to change without notice.

steps: Tell a friend about HACU banking healthy.
Friend applies online, in a branch, or by phone and gives your full name.
Your $25 referral payout is deposited into your primary savings within 5 days of their account opening (up to $500/year).
timing: Referral payout deposited within 5 days of the new member account opening.
when_cash_arrives: $25 deposited to your share savings within 5 days of your friend's new membership opening. The friend only has to join - no transactions, direct deposit, or balance requirements - so a same-day joiner puts cash in your account within a week.
maximize: Fastest qualification in this wave: the friend just becomes a new HACU member - have them complete the online application through your referral the same day you refer them.
No debit transactions, direct deposit, or minimum balance, so nothing delays the 5-day payout clock.
The friend must be 100% new to HACU (no prior membership); HACU employees are excluded from payouts.

speed_history.rationale: Official terms: $25 deposited within 5 days of the new member's account opening, with zero activity hurdles - a same-day join pays out within a week.
